title: Quantum Correlations and Entanglement in Generalized Dicke-Ising Models
summary: Quantum systems inside high-Q cavities offer an excellent testbed for the control of emergent symmetries induced by light and their interplay with quantum matter. Recently several developments in cavity experiments with neutral atoms and other quantum objects such as ions motivate the study of their quantum correlated properties and their entanglement to tailor and control the behavior of the system.
